name: @vaipakam/keeper
description: Vaipakam's first-party autonomous keeper Cloudflare Worker (Stage 3 PR2 + architectural-rebalance commit of the Worker split — see docs/DesignsAndPlans/Stage3WorkerSplitPlan.md). Cron-driven, no HTTP surface. The single Worker that holds KEEPER_PRIVATE_KEY (staging plan §2 least-privilege contract: signing key lives on exactly one Worker). Today: HF watcher loop + autonomous on-chain liquidation submission + Telegram / Push alert dispatch on HF band downgrades + daily oracle snapshot signer (OracleFacet.captureDailyPriceSnapshot, moved from agent). Also LIVE (per RangeOffersDesign.md and §7 of the Stage 3 plan; this said 'Tomorrow'): the off-chain offer matcher, scheduled every cron tick, for the Phase 1 Range Orders + Lender Partial Fills system, submitting matchOffers(lenderId, borrowerId) to earn the 1% LIF matcher fee. Holds privileged secrets (KEEPER_PRIVATE_KEY, ZEROEX_API_KEY, ONEINCH_API_KEY, TG_BOT_TOKEN, PUSH_CHANNEL_PK) in the Cloudflare secret store; never serves user-facing reads. Distinct from the public reference keeper bot at `vaipakam-keeper-bot` (sibling repo) — that one is for third-party operators; this one is the project's own.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . --noEmit && tsc -p bench --noEmit && tsc -p host --noEmit && tsc -p e2e --noEmit && node scripts/check-keep-vars.mjs
scripts.e2e:anvil: pnpm run e2e:anvil:single && pnpm run e2e:anvil:mesh
scripts.build:host: esbuild host/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/keeper-host.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
